text:
Maya: Rooftop happy hour + analog games night next Thu? Thinking string lights, cheap sake/kombucha, ramen truck outside, and a couple of board games/ping-pong. Who's in? :sparkles:
Jordan: count me in. do we need $ for food truck or can we ask finance for small social budget? :money_with_wings:
Priya: I can coordinate the ramen truck if people are OK with $8-12/pp. happy to ask vendors I know.
Leo: Quick question — rooftop chairs ok? Also we have a foldable ping-pong set in closet 3A.
Sophie: I'll bring Catan and a deck of Uno. Also can do veggie snacks. :carrot:
Maya: Awesome. @Priya if you can get quotes that'd be great. @Jordan maybe you can check with finance? If not, we can do pay-at-truck.
Jordan: I can ping finance. If it's under $400 we should be fine on social budget. Otherwise pay-at-truck is simpler.
Priya: Vendor A: mobile ramen + vega options, ~$10/pp; Vendor B: cheaper but needs 2-hour min, ~$7/pp. I'll DM details.
poll-bot: Poll created — React to this message to vote: 1) Thu 6:30pm 2) Fri 7pm 3) Sat 5pm
Maya: React with :one::two::three: and also add :beer: if you're bringing +1.
Leo: Thu :one: — better for weekday unwind
Sophie: Sat :three: — prefer earlier on weekend
Jordan: Thu :one: and I can check budget now.
Priya: Thu :one: seems easiest for vendor availability.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Dim Sips & Analog Games" Thu 6:30pm — RSVP open
Maya: Sweet. Current tally based on reactions: Thu (4), Fri (1), Sat (1). Looks like Thu wins. I'll put up RSVP form tomorrow and reserve rooftop string lights.
Sophie: Yay! Can someone bring extra cups/napkins? I can grab skewers/sauces.
Jordan: I can bring extra folding chairs and the kettle for hot tea.
Maya: Perfect. Thanks team :heart:
